name: Mandapa, A Ritz Carlton Reserve
positioning: Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve: a riverside villa and suite resort in Ubud, Bali, with a spa and private pools
best_for: Travelers who want a spa and wellness stay by the Ayung River in Ubud
Families who want a children's programme and villas with private pools

facts.text: Mandapa is in Ubud, in Bali's cultural and spiritual heart, where the jungle meets the Ayung River.
Each guest has a dedicated Patih, or butler.
The villas have private pools and forest, rice terrace or riverfront views.
Sawah Terrace Restaurant serves heritage dishes of the Indonesian archipelago.
Dining Beyond offers private dining in corners of the property or at offsite locations.
The riverfront spa has five treatment rooms, a yoga pavilion, a meditation temple, a vitality pool, saunas and relaxation areas.
Complimentary sunrise and sunset yoga is offered daily to hotel guests.
Mandapa Camp is a children's and family programme.
Ayung River white-water rafting trips end at the Mandapa river pier.
Guests can join a Full Moon blessing ceremony at the hotel's lava stone temple.

highlights.text: Kubu at Mandapa has a zero-waste dining philosophy and sources ingredients from within 100km.
Ambar Ubud Bar is perched on a cliff and serves handcrafted cocktails and Japanese fusion food, with daily live jazz.
The accommodations blend Balinese heritage with contemporary elegance, with design by Jeffrey Wilkes.
The spa offers sessions with a local Balinese healer.
Condé Nast Traveler lists Mandapa in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2023, 2025 and 2026.

considerations.text: Mandapa is in Sayan, a 15- to 45-minute drive from central Ubud depending on traffic.
The official rooms page lists no accessible rooms at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the secluded jungle location requires transfer time to beaches and other attractions.
